blocks.html:
Mapa progresji

Odhaczaj kamienie milowe w miarę ich osiągania, twój postęp jest zapisywany w tej przeglądarce, a kopię zapasową możesz wyeksportować z paska narzędzi w dowolnym momencie.

blocks.title: Przed premierą
blocks.goalHtml: Lock in the decisions that are hard or impossible to undo later. Pre-launch, now through October 4, 2026.

milestones.labelHtml: Create your account and install the client via Steam or PURPLE exitlag.com1 lagofast.com2
milestones.whyHtml: AION 2 is PC-only at global launch, playable through Steam or NCsoft's PURPLE launcher. No console or mobile version exists for the West yet.

milestones.labelHtml: Pick faction and server together with any friends before you log in guildorder.com3
milestones.whyHtml: Faction and server choice is effectively permanent, and Legions (guilds) are faction-locked, so this decides who you can play with.

milestones.labelHtml: Pick your class, tank, melee or ranged DPS, magic DPS, healer, or support mmoexp.com4 marketing
milestones.whyHtml: Eight classes exist: Templar (tank), Gladiator and Assassin (melee DPS), Ranger (ranged DPS), Sorcerer and Spiritmaster (magic DPS), Cleric (healer), and Chanter (hybrid support).

milestones.labelHtml: Play the free Launch Scale Test, September 17 to 18, 2026 aion2hub, 2026-095
milestones.whyHtml: This is open to anyone via Steam sign-up and is your first real chance to test performance and settings before launch.

milestones.labelHtml: Decide, buy or skip the Founder's Pack timesaver.gg6 single source
milestones.whyHtml: Standard ($24.99) bundles 5 days of Advance Access plus 30 days of Membership, the same account-affecting items as Deluxe and Ultimate, which only add cosmetics.

milestones.labelHtml: If buying, preload around Sept 28 and log in during Advance Access, Sept 30 to Oct 4 aion2hub, 2026-097
milestones.whyHtml: Advance Access is a 5-day head start before the public October 5 global launch.

milestones.labelHtml: Confirm your PC meets minimum spec, Ryzen 5 2600 or i5-10500, GTX 1050 Ti noping.com8 single source
milestones.whyHtml: Recommended is Ryzen 7 3700X or i7-11700, 16GB RAM, RTX 2070, worth checking against your rig now rather than on launch day.

milestones.labelHtml: Decide whether the $15 a month Membership fits your plans massivelyop, 2026-079 mmorpg.com, 2026-0710
milestones.whyHtml: Membership is optional to play at all, but it gates trading on the Market and the Kinah to Quna currency exchange.

milestones.labelHtml: Save your keybind and settings changes before your first real fight mmoexp.com11 marketing
milestones.whyHtml: Moving Defiance off Spacebar, binding Sprint to Shift, and enabling combat overlays are a starting point to tweak in the Launch Scale Test, not gospel.

blocks.extraHtml: Gotowe, gdy: masz podjęte decyzje co do frakcji, serwera, klasy i Founder's Pack, i zalogowałeś się przynajmniej raz podczas Launch Scale Test lub Advance Access.

blocks.title: Pierwsze godziny
blocks.goalHtml: Get moving without wasting anything you cannot get back. Level 1 to about 12, your first few hours.

milestones.labelHtml: Clear your first Sealed Dungeon in your starter region u4n.com1 overgear.com2
milestones.whyHtml: Sealed Dungeons in Verteron and Altgard are solo, ungated by gear score, and pay out Daevanion Points from your very first hours.

milestones.labelHtml: Level your main damage skill to skill-level 8 fextralife wiki3 oslink.io4
milestones.whyHtml: Skills gain bonus chosen effects at level 8, 12, and 16, so a skill lagging behind these breakpoints will feel weak.

milestones.labelHtml: Unlock your wings, reported around level 10 thegamer.com5 single source
milestones.whyHtml: Flight is a core combat and traversal mechanic, not just cosmetic transport, and some Abyss boss mechanics reportedly require it.

milestones.labelHtml: Test a Mastery Skill respec at least once fextralife wiki6 single source
milestones.whyHtml: Skill Points refund for a small Kinah fee, so trying a different core skill early carries little risk.

milestones.labelHtml: Hold at least one Shugo Fiesta key unspent boostroom, 2026-027 single source
milestones.whyHtml: Spending limited daily keys before reaching max level reduces their endgame reward value.

milestones.labelHtml: Reach level 12 aion2hub.com8 fextralife wiki9
milestones.whyHtml: This is when your first Daevanion board, Nezekan, becomes available, a good marker that you are through the opening hours.

blocks.extraHtml: Gotowe, gdy: przeszedłeś Sealed Dungeon, odblokowałeś skrzydła, podniosłeś podstawową umiejętność powyżej poziomu 8 i osiągnąłeś poziom 12.

blocks.title: Pierwsza tablica talentów i pierwsze grupy
blocks.goalHtml: Open the Daevanion board and start playing with other people. Level 12 to 23.

milestones.labelHtml: Open your first Daevanion board, Nezekan, at level 12 aion2hub.com1 fextralife wiki2
milestones.whyHtml: This is a permanent, separate-from-gear power source that guides call easy to overlook while rushing the story.

milestones.labelHtml: Spend Nezekan points toward one Special Skill Node target fextralife wiki3
milestones.whyHtml: Node costs run grey 1, green 2, blue 3, orange 4 points. Tracing the cheapest path to nodes that support one loadout beats grabbing every nearby node for raw power.

milestones.labelHtml: Reach level 20 for your second board, Zikel daum, 2025-11-204 kr-era single source
milestones.whyHtml: This board is themed around damage amp and resist. The board level ladder is confirmed generally, but the exact stat theme is a single KR-era source and could shift for global.

milestones.labelHtml: Push your core skills past the level 12 specialization breakpoint fextralife wiki5 oslink.io6
milestones.whyHtml: Skills gain bonus chosen effects at level 8, 12, and 16, so a skill lagging behind these thresholds will feel clunky in group content.

milestones.labelHtml: Clear Fire Temple once, around level 20 aion2kina.com7 single source
milestones.whyHtml: It has a high drop rate for unique items and Kinah, and works in Explore Mode for alt characters too.

milestones.labelHtml: Join an active Legion mein-mmo, 2026-098 single source
milestones.whyHtml: Solo players lose time to slow party-finding, bad pickup groups, and missed weekly group clears.

blocks.extraHtml: Gotowe, gdy: masz otwarte tablice Nezekan i Zikel, twoje podstawowe umiejętności są powyżej progu na poziomie 12, i jesteś w Legion.

blocks.title: Stigmy, energia i twój pierwszy prawdziwy build
blocks.goalHtml: Commit to one PvE setup and start touching endgame-adjacent systems. Level 23 to about 40.

milestones.labelHtml: Unlock your first Stigma slot at level 23 aion2hub.com1 boostroom.com2
milestones.whyHtml: Stigmas are equippable skill-enhancement stones that add build-defining abilities on top of your class kit. They run on Stigma Shards, a separate currency from normal Skill Points.

milestones.labelHtml: Equip 4 Stigmas in one coherent PvE set aion2hub.com3 single source
milestones.whyHtml: Building a PvP set before your PvE rotation is stable wastes scarce Shards. A separate KR-era source describes a longer 23/30/40/45/50/55 slot ladder, so treat the total slot count as provisional until you see it in the client.

milestones.labelHtml: Reach level 30 for your third board, Vaizel daum, 2025-11-204 kr-era single source
milestones.whyHtml: This board is themed around crit damage amp and resist, same board ladder as Nezekan and Zikel, with the stat theme sourced from a single KR-era article.

milestones.labelHtml: Clear Abyss Depths once, around level 30 aion2kina.com5 single source
milestones.whyHtml: This party dungeon teaches aerial combat and group mechanics and drops pre-endgame gear ahead of the level cap.

milestones.labelHtml: Clear Draconian Bastion once, around level 40 aion2kina.com6 single source
milestones.whyHtml: A 5-player follow-up to Abyss Depths that drops more pre-endgame gear before you hit the level cap.

milestones.labelHtml: Fill every Arcana card slot with something usable expcarry.com7
milestones.whyHtml: Arcana cards add item level, combat stats, set effects, and skill levels all at once, so an empty slot is wasted potential.

milestones.labelHtml: Enhance your weapon ahead of your armor and accessories boostroom.com8 overgear.com9
milestones.whyHtml: Weapon enhancement gives the single biggest felt damage boost. Enhancement materials are scarce once early one-time quests are used up, so save them for gear you will keep.

milestones.labelHtml: Have an officer rent your Legion's hideout, 1,000,000 Kinah guildmanager.app10 contested
milestones.whyHtml: Only an officer can rent the hideout, for about 24 days at a time. Independent sources dispute that Legions have levels, a Legion Hall, warehouses, or buffs at all, so treat any "Legion level 5" claim as unconfirmed.

milestones.labelHtml: Fill at least one Pantheon Colossus slot vortexgaming.io11 single source
milestones.whyHtml: Pantheon is an easy-to-overlook permanent passive-stat system built from Statues and Colossi, separate from your Daevanion board.

blocks.extraHtml: Gotowe, gdy: masz pełny zestaw PvE z 4 Stigmami, przeszedłeś raz Abyss Depths i raz Draconian Bastion, a twoja broń prowadzi w ulepszeniach nad resztą ekwipunku.

blocks.title: Osiąganie limitu poziomu
blocks.goalHtml: Close out the remaining boards and advanced Stigmas before settling in. About level 40 to 45.

milestones.labelHtml: Reach level 40 for your fourth board, Triniel daum, 2025-11-201 kr-era single source
milestones.whyHtml: Same board unlock pattern continuing from Nezekan, Zikel, and Vaizel, themed around multi-hit accuracy and resist.

milestones.labelHtml: Reach level 45, the KR-era level cap mmoexp.com2 marketing contested
milestones.whyHtml: KR/TW later raised this to 50, and global may launch with a separate "Level 20" skill and Stigma enhancement cap instead. NC has not clarified which numbers apply globally.

milestones.labelHtml: At level 45, open your Ariel and Azphel Daevanion boards fextralife wiki3
milestones.whyHtml: This closes out the confirmed 6-board Daevanion ladder. A single unverified source names two more boards, Marchutan and Yustiel, at the same level, so re-check this after launch.

milestones.labelHtml: Complete the level 45 stigma quest for 2 Greater Stigma slots differ.blog4
milestones.whyHtml: Elyos run "The Shattered Stigma" and Asmodians run "The Shulak's Stigma" to unlock these slots.

milestones.labelHtml: Reach item level 1,000 before attempting the Ascension Trial mein-mmo, 2026-095 kr-era single source
milestones.whyHtml: Item level gates entry, but combat power, which also counts Daevanion, Pantheon, Arcana, and skill levels, decides whether you can actually clear the fight. Do not confuse the two.

milestones.labelHtml: Clear your first Transcendence or Conquest dungeon expcarry.com6 u4n.com7 kr-era
milestones.whyHtml: These are the endgame source of Arcana cards and high-value drops once your gear can handle them.

blocks.extraHtml: Gotowe, gdy: masz otwarte wszystkie potwierdzone tablice z poziomu 45, masz sloty Greater Stigma i przeszedłeś dungeon Transcendence lub Conquest.

blocks.title: Pierwsze tygodnie na limicie poziomu
blocks.goalHtml: Turn raw cap power into a repeatable weekly routine without wasting resources.

milestones.labelHtml: Open an Odyle Energy reward cube on a Transcendence or Conquest run u4n.com1 aion2kina.com2 kr-era
milestones.whyHtml: These give the best reward for the 40-energy reward cube cost of any content type.

milestones.labelHtml: Keep Odyle Energy below its reported 560 cap thegameswiki.com3 mmoexp.com4 kr-era
milestones.whyHtml: Passive regeneration stops once the pool is full, so sitting capped wastes potential income.

milestones.labelHtml: Clear all 7 of your weekly Daily Dungeon entries u4n.com5 contested
milestones.whyHtml: One source cites 7 free entries a week, expandable via tickets, but exact weekly counts vary between sources, so verify in-client.

milestones.labelHtml: Equip a free stat title you already qualify for aion2hub.com6
milestones.whyHtml: Check the achievement panel periodically for cheap stat titles rather than actively farming them. Titles come from PvP rank, Arena tiers, boss kills, and more.

milestones.labelHtml: Reconfirm your Membership decision now that trading matters massivelyop, 2026-077 official
milestones.whyHtml: The $15 a month Membership gates the player Market and the Kinah to Quna currency exchange.

milestones.labelHtml: Enhance your weapon to +8, the first safe damage breakpoint boostroom.com8 single source
milestones.whyHtml: Pushing enhancement further on gear you might replace soon wastes scarce Enhance Stones. +8 is described as a damage-smoothing milestone, especially for weapons.

milestones.labelHtml: Decide whether to roll an alt now that clears feel fast boostroom, 2026-029 mein-mmo, 2026-0910
milestones.whyHtml: Per-character systems like Battle Pass, Stigma builds, and gear do not share progress across characters, and an 84-run account-wide weekly soft cap discourages heavy alt farming for Kinah.

blocks.extraHtml: Gotowe, gdy: masz powtarzalną tygodniową listę zadań, którą faktycznie kończysz w większości tygodni, i podjąłeś świadomą decyzję co do Membership i altów, zamiast wpaść w nią przypadkiem.

blocks.title: Zweryfikuj ponownie po globalnej premierze
blocks.goalHtml: Check every KR-era assumption above against what actually ships on October 5, 2026.

milestones.labelHtml: Confirm the real level cap, KR/TW: 50, separate Level 20 skill cap reported mmoexp.com1 marketing contested
milestones.whyHtml: NC has not clarified which cap number applies at global launch.

milestones.labelHtml: Confirm the Stigma unlock level and slot count in the client, KR: level 23, 4 slots expcarry.com2 kr-era single source
milestones.whyHtml: A separate KR-era source describes a longer 23/30/40/45/50/55 slot ladder, and a Stigma level cap raised from 20 to 25 past level 45. Neither is confirmed for global.

milestones.labelHtml: Confirm the Daevanion node reset cost, KR set it to 500 Kinah per node expcarry.com3 kr-era single source
milestones.whyHtml: The source itself flags that this figure could change for global.

milestones.labelHtml: Confirm whether the Marchutan and Yustiel Daevanion boards exist fextralife wiki4 contested
milestones.whyHtml: The confirmed board ladder is Nezekan, Zikel, Vaizel, Triniel, Ariel, and Azphel. A single unverified source adds these two more at level 45.

milestones.labelHtml: Confirm Odyle Energy's real cap and regen rate, KR: 560 cap, contested u4n.com5 savetip.co.kr6 contested
milestones.whyHtml: Sources disagree between a 560 cap with 15-per-3-hours regen and a weekly-accumulation reading closer to 1,400 total.

milestones.labelHtml: Confirm your weekly dungeon entry limits in the client u4n.com7 exitlag.com8 contested
milestones.whyHtml: Expedition counts range from 3 to 21 per week and Transcendence from 2 to 14 per week depending on the source.

milestones.labelHtml: Confirm whether Fortress Sieges or Legion levels exist at all timesaver.gg9 guildmanager.app10 contested
milestones.whyHtml: One source claims hundreds-of-players siege warfare is back, another says original-form sieges are unconfirmed. Separately, sources dispute whether Legions have levels, a Hall, or buffs at all.

milestones.labelHtml: Confirm daily and weekly reset times for your own region server aion2kina.com11 kr-era single source
milestones.whyHtml: Every reset-time figure found in research comes from KR/TW servers, not a confirmed global time zone.

milestones.labelHtml: Confirm the 84-run alt penalty percentage before farming alts mmoexp.com12 marketing single source
milestones.whyHtml: The specific "90% reduction" figure comes from a single lower-trust source, though the existence of an 84-run soft cap is corroborated elsewhere.

milestones.labelHtml: Confirm Expedition party size before committing to a static group overgear.com13 thegameswiki.com14 contested
milestones.whyHtml: Steam materials reportedly say 5-player, older teasers said 4-player, and one wiki cites 8-player expeditions.

blocks.extraHtml: Gotowe, gdy: sprawdziłeś każdą sporną pozycję lub pozycję z ery KR powyżej z oficjalnymi patch notes lub własnym interfejsem w grze po 5 października i zaktualizowałeś swój plan.
